CIVIL MINUTES - GENERAL                              
Case No.  ED CV 20-00107 FMO (SPx)             Date February 25, 2020       
Title     Sun World International, LLC v. The Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and
          Insurance Company, et al.                                         
Present: The Honorable Fernando M. Olguin, United States District Judge     
         Vanessa Figueroa                      None Present                 
           Deputy Clerk                   Court Reporter / Recorder         
     Attorneys Present for Plaintiffs:  Attorneys Present for Defendants:   
            None Present                       None Present                 
Proceedings:    (In Chambers) Order to Show Cause Re: Dismissal Re: Lack of 
                Prosecution                                                 
    Absent a showing of good cause, an action must be dismissed without prejudice if the
summons and complaint are not served on a defendant within 90 days after the complaint is filed. 
Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(m).  Generally, a defendant must answer the complaint within 21 days after
service (60 days if the defendant is the United States).  Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(a).  The court may
dismiss the action prior to the 90 days, however, if plaintiff(s) has/have not diligently prosecuted
the action.                                                                  
    In the present case, it appears that one or more of these time periods has not been met. 
Accordingly, the court, on its own motion, orders plaintiff(s) to show cause in writing on or before
March 3, 2020, why this action should not be dismissed for lack of prosecution.  Pursuant to Fed.
R. Civ. P. 78(b), the court finds that this matter is appropriate for submission without oral
argument.  The Order to Show Cause will stand submitted upon the filing of:  
#    An answer by the following defendant(s):                                
    PACIFIC COAST PROCESS SOLUTIONS, INC. and GEORGE WHITE                  
#    Plaintiff’s application for entry of default pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 55(a):
    PACIFIC COAST PROCESS SOLUTIONS, INC. and GEORGE WHITE                  
on or before the date indicated above.  Failure to file a timely response to this Order to Show
Cause shall result in the action or the above defendant(s) being dismissed for lack of prosecution
and for failure to comply with the orders of the court.  See Local Rule 41; Fed. R. Civ. P. 4 & 41(b);
Link v. Wabash R.R. Co., 370 U.S. 626, 629-30, 82 S.Ct. 1386, 1388 (1962).   
                                                       00   :   00
